title: Parcours 42km du Mont-Blanc — carte PDF (édition 2025)
claims: The PDF titled 'Parcours 42km du Mont-Blanc' is linked from the official French 42 km page as 'Carte PDF'.

It maps the 42 km route on an IGN topographic base from the Chamonix start/finish through Les Bois, Lavancher, Argentière, Le Tour, Vallorcine and La Flégère, with the normal route in green and a yellow bypass itinerary.
The file sits in the organiser's 2025-06 upload path, is a one-page static PDF rather than a GPX file, and carries no stated reuse licence.

verification.note: 2026-11-21 从官方法文 42 km 页 'Carte PDF' 链接下载并读取全文（1 页，1,862,445 字节）：IGN 地形底图，绿色 normal route、黄色 itinéraire de contournement，标出 Chamonix 起点/终点、Les Bois、Lavancher、Argentière、Le Tour、Vallorcine、La Flégère、Col des Montets 与时间障碍/补给/停车/厕所。文件路径为 2025-06，属 2025 届图件，不是 GPX。
